{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Customer_age sentinel value (-1) count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders count:", (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of channel
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows count:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:\n", sales_df.isnull().sum())"}
